topic: your past doesn't decide your future
lines: #Where you started doesn't decide where you *finish.*
Not your family. Not your *mistakes.*
Not the years you *wasted.*
#Your past is a *lesson.* Not a life sentence.
Some of the strongest people you'll meet started with *nothing.*
No support. No plan. No *example* to follow.
#They just decided the story would *change* with them.
They didn't have a head start. They had a *decision.*
They decided they were done being *defined* by yesterday.
And it *did.*
#You can't go back and change the *beginning.*
But you can start *right* now, and change the ending.
Every single day is a new *page.*
So stop rereading the old *chapters.*
The mistakes you made taught you something *valuable.*
The pain gave you *depth.*
Use it. Don't *live* in it.
Stop letting people who knew the old you *define* you.
#You are allowed to become someone *new.*
Starting *tonight.*
end: Send this to someone who needs a fresh start.
